title: 第6章 嚣张的凌云恺
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
沈炼表面不动声色，似不把此事放在心里，但其内心是激动的，前段时间千户陆文昭推荐他当副千户，如果将这件案子拿下，那副千户的职位就十拿九稳了。
正所谓一人得道鸡犬升天，作为心腹的殷澄自然会水涨船高，说不定也能升上一级呢，所以他显得比沈炼还高兴。
“兄弟们，出去办差了。”
随着殷澄一声喊，霎时间便从屋内走出二十余名锦衣卫。
此时已是傍晚，大多数锦衣卫都下工回家了，剩下的锦衣卫都是值班的。
见诸人以至，沈炼先是从他们身上扫过一遍，然后说道：“老齐和小刘看管卫所，其余人跟我去金陵楼。”
说罢沈炼一马当先往外走去，殷澄和陈浩紧随其后，其他人也连忙迈步跟上。
金陵楼是一座开在京城城南的酒楼，地属明时坊境内，规模算是中等酒楼，凭借着一手好吃的金陵菜在城南算是小有名气。
当沈炼一行人到达金陵楼时，外面围了不少人在看热闹，但是当他们看到锦衣卫来了，登时便一哄而散。
“小人五城兵马司捕快梁焕见过大人！”
沈炼一行人刚要进入金陵楼，却见他们旁边走出了三名捕快。
沈炼点了点头，道：“听殷澄说是你们通知锦衣卫的？”
“是小人通知的，小人正在街上巡街听说发生了命案，小人立刻便赶到了此地。”说话的是那位叫做梁焕的捕快，其他二人则老老实实的站在其身后，梁焕脸色紧张，有些忐忑的说道：“当小人来到此地发现死者身份是一名公公后，便想马上通知锦衣卫，恰好遇到了殷小旗，现场的物品除了那位公公的腰牌，其它的我们没触碰过。”
“好了，没你们的事了，你们离开吧！”沈炼挥了挥手道。
“谢大人！”三人如释重负，对沈炼鞠躬示意后，便匆匆忙忙离开。
五城兵马司平时也就负责治安、火禁及疏理泃渠街道等事，像这种牵连到东厂公公的大案他们自然不敢自作主张，只能由锦衣卫或东厂的番子来接手。
“王军去镇抚司请仵作验尸，其他人跟我一起进去，待五城兵马司的人走后，沈炼吩咐大家道。
“是，大人！”
众人齐声应答，然后便一起进入了金陵楼，沈炼和几名锦衣卫去检查死尸，其他人三五成群的搜寻金陵楼的各个房间角落。
陈浩也装模作样的看了看现场，郭真被谁杀的他可是一清二楚。

要说这郭真和沈炼还真是有些渊源，当年萨尔浒之战西路军几乎全军覆没，只活下来三个人，其中就有郭真、沈炼、还有一个是锦衣卫千户陆文昭。
后来郭真成了司礼监的秉笔太监，负责营造司，陆文昭则成了锦衣卫千户，最差的沈炼也成了锦衣卫百户。
这三人沈炼是最没有门路的，他最大的靠山也就是陆文昭了。
而陆文昭和郭真则是信王朱由检的人，朱由检为了争夺皇位，安排郭真在督造天启皇帝的宝船时做下手脚，害的天启皇帝落水重病，事后怕走露风声，信王又安排北斋将郭真引至金陵楼让陆文昭、丁白缨师兄妹杀其灭口，随后又利用魏忠贤的势力杀了陆文昭和丁白缨！
直白的说，绣春刀修罗战场就是由信王朱由检争夺皇位开始，到当上皇帝结束，沈炼在其中扮演的只不过是一只小虾米而已！
“大人钱箱是空的，银子都没了！”
这时殷澄从账房来到了沈炼旁边，陈浩也凑了过去。
“原来是东厂的郭公公，难怪看着眼熟！”
通过腰牌和长相对比沈炼认出了此人正是郭真，沈炼和郭真八年未见，沈炼能认出他更多的还是因为腰牌上的身份。
“大人！”被沈炼安排去镇抚司衙门的王军，急急忙忙跑进来金陵楼。
沈炼眉头微皱，他道：“不是让你去镇抚司衙门请仵作来验尸吗？”
王军还未回答，殷澄不耐的打了他一拳，嚷道：“人呢？你倒是说话呀！”
王军满腹委屈的道：“回大人的话，恕小的没用，叫衙门里值夜的总旗撞见了，他带了很多人说话就到！”
“你！”殷澄攥住了王军的衣领，气急道：“让他们看到了，这事还能到咱们大人手上吗？这都半年了才赶上这么一个大案子！”说着殷澄打了一个嗝，嘴里传出了很大的酒气。
“喝多了？”沈炼冷冷的道。

content_en:
Shen Lian was calm on the surface, as if he didn't take the matter to heart, but inside he was excited. Qianhu Lu Wenzhao recommended him to be Deputy Qianhu some time ago. If this case is taken down, the position of Deputy Qianhu will be guaranteed.
As the saying goes, if one person attains the Tao, a chicken or a dog will rise to heaven. As a confidant, Yin Cheng will naturally rise to the top, and maybe he can be promoted to a higher level, so he seems to be even happier than Shen Lian.
"Brothers, we're out on errands."
Following Yin Cheng's shout, more than twenty Jinyi guards walked out of the house in an instant.
It was already evening, most of the Jinyiwei had gone home from work, and the remaining Jinyiwei were on duty.
Seeing everyone arriving, Shen Lian glanced at them first, and then said: "Lao Qi and Xiao Liu will take care of the guardhouse, and the rest of them will follow me to Jinling Tower."
After saying that, Shen Lian took the lead and walked out, followed closely by Yin Cheng and Chen Hao, and the others quickly followed.
Jinling Restaurant is a restaurant located in the south of the capital city, within the territory of Mingshifang. It is a medium-sized restaurant and is somewhat famous in the south of the city for its delicious Jinling cuisine.
When Shen Lian and his party arrived at Jinling Tower, many people gathered outside to watch the excitement, but when they saw the Jin Yiwei coming, they immediately dispersed.
"The villain, Captain Liang Huan of the Five Cities Military and Horse Division, has met your Excellency!"
Shen Lian and his party were about to enter Jinling Tower when they saw three police officers walking out beside them.
Shen Lian nodded and said, "I heard Yin Cheng said it was you who informed Jin Yiwei?"
"It was informed by the villain. I was patrolling the street when I heard that a murder had occurred. I rushed here immediately." The one who spoke was the detective named Liang Huan, and the other two stood behind him honestly. Liang Huan looked nervous. He said with some anxiety: "When the villain came here and found out that the deceased was a father-in-law, he wanted to notify Jin Yiwei immediately. He happened to meet Yin Xiaoqi. Except for the father-in-law's waistband, we have not touched any other items on the scene."
"Okay, it's none of your business, you can leave!" Shen Lian waved his hand.
"Thank you, Sir!" The three of them were relieved, bowed to Shen Lian, and left in a hurry.
The Wucheng Military and Horse Division is usually responsible for public security, fire control, and clearing the streets of Dingqu. Naturally, they do not dare to take action on a major case like this involving Dongchang's father-in-law, and can only be taken over by Jin Yiwei or Dongchang's fanzi.
"Wang Jun went to the Zhenfu Division to ask the deceased to perform an autopsy. The others went in with me. After the people from the Five Cities Soldiers and Horses Division left, Shen Lian gave everyone instructions.
"Yes, sir! "
Everyone responded in unison, and then entered the Jinling Tower together. Shen Lian and several Jinyi guards went to check the dead body, while others searched the corners of the rooms in the Jinling Tower in small groups.
Chen Hao also pretended to look at the scene. He knew exactly who Guo Zhen was killed by.
Guo Zhen and Shen Lian really have some connection. In the Battle of Sarhu, the Western Route Army was almost completely wiped out, and only three people survived. Among them were Guo Zhen, Shen Lian, and Lu Wenzhao, a member of the Qianhu of the Jinyi Guards.
Later, Guo Zhen became the eunuch Bingbi of the Superintendent of Ceremonies and was responsible for the construction department. Lu Wenzhao became the member of the Jinyiwei Qianhu, and the worst Shen Lian became the Jinyiwei Baihu.
Of the three, Shen Lian is the least connected, and his biggest backer is Lu Wenzhao.
Lu Wenzhao and Guo Zhen were followers of the Xinwang Zhu Youjian. In order to compete for the throne, Zhu Youjian arranged for Guo Zhen to tamper with the construction of Emperor Tianqi's treasure ship, which caused Emperor Tianqi to fall into the water and become seriously ill. Later, fearing that the news would be exposed, King Xin arranged for Beizhai to lure Guo Zhen to Jinling Tower so that Lu Wenzhao and Ding Baiying could kill him. Then he used Wei Zhongxian's power to kill Lu Wenzhao and Ding Baiying!
To put it bluntly, Xiuchundao Shura Battlefield started with King Xin Zhu Youjian fighting for the throne and ended when he became the emperor. Shen Lian played nothing more than a little shrimp in it!
"My lord, the cash box is empty and all the money is gone! "
At this time Yin Cheng came from the accounting roomWhen he came to Shen Lian's side, Chen Hao also approached.
"It turns out to be Eunuch Guo from Dongchang, no wonder he looks familiar!"
Shen Lian recognized this person as Guo Zhen by comparing his waistband and appearance. Shen Lian and Guo Zhen had not seen each other for eight years. Shen Lian was able to recognize him more because of the identity on his waistband.
"Sir!" Wang Jun, who was arranged by Shen Lian to suppress Fusi Yamen, hurriedly ran into Jinling Tower.
Shen Lian frowned slightly and said, "Didn't I ask you to go to the Zhenfu Si Yamen to ask a widower to do an autopsy?"
Before Wang Jun could answer, Yin Cheng punched him impatiently and shouted, "Where's the man? You're talking!"
Wang Jun said with full of grievance: "Sir, please forgive me for being useless. I asked the general Qi who was on night duty in the Yamen to bump into me. He brought many people and just talked!"
"You!" Yin Cheng grabbed Wang Jun's collar and said angrily: "If they see it, can this matter still be in our hands? It has taken half a year to catch up with such a big case!" Yin Cheng burped as he spoke, and there was a strong smell of alcohol coming from his mouth.
"Drink too much?" Shen Lian said coldly.
